descFull: Stop making your AI re-read your codebase. Stacklit maps your repo once and keeps the map fresh. In a 450-session test, agents ran 82% fewer grep and glob searches. Free, MIT, one Go binary. Sets up Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and 22 more.
